title: When the Machine Sings
author: Ines Whitlock
blurb: Odile Eriksen, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
